provenance.instrument: Nether Providence Township Zoning Ordinance (Chapter 300 Zoning, Ord. No. 225 of 3-14-1940, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 NE1093, Township of Nether Providence, Delaware County (300-112A: Township Building at 214 Sykes Lane, Wallingford). Chapter 300 was adopted 3-14-1940 by Ord. No. 225 and much amended, chiefly by Ord. No. 581 of 12-10-1992. The bar on living quarters in accessory buildings (300-130) and the accessory building size and height limits (300-128.1) date from Ord. No. 743 of 5-14-2009. New Laws: 'There are currently no known new laws for this Code.' No zoning rewrite was found
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: 'Includes legislation through 08-28-2025.' New Laws: none listed
checks: The zoning chapter has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law suite or similar use
'An accessory building shall not be used as living quarters or sleeping quarters. No person shall construct within any accessory building any bathroom, laundry facilities, or kitchen' (300-130)

R-1 permits 'any of the following purposes and for no other', the first being 'Single-family detached dwelling', a building 'for one family only' (300-8A, 300-1). R-2, R-3, R-3a and R-3b take the R-1 uses

A two-family detached dwelling, with 'one family living wholly or partly over the other', is permitted only in R-4 and R-5 (300-41B, 300-48A). The old sections on changing existing houses into two-family dwellings were repealed (editor's notes to 300-13, 300-21, 300-28, 300-36, 300-46, 300-53)
Lot area is set 'per family' for every building 'used in whole or in part as a dwelling' (for example 300-9, 300-42)

Only one accessory building is permitted on a property (300-129E). In residence districts it is at most 10 ft at the wall and 20 ft at the peak, and its footprint is at most 500 sq ft unless the Zoning Hearing Board grants a special exception (300-128.1)

In the RP district a house may be combined with up to two professional office units, and any dwelling unit there must be owner-occupied (300-36.1B(3)). In R-5a an apartment house may hold living quarters for watchmen and caretakers employed on the premises (300-55B(3))
No section read bars a use variance. Variances are heard under MPC 910.2 (300-122A(5)) and expire after 18 months without a building permit (300-124)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Nether Providence Township. Read in a browser on eCode360, one page at a time, on 2026-11-15, in print view. Searched the code (scope all) for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, family apartment, ECHO, elder cottage, granny, relative, caretaker, guest house, carriage house, servants, tenant house, living quarters, second dwelling, conversion, accessory suite, farm dwelling, two-family, caregiver and cooking facilities. Hits were 300-130, the two-family definitions and district sections, and the family day care caregiver definition. Read: 300-1, Article III (300-4 to 300-6), the district articles for R-1, R-1a, R-2, R-3, R-3a, RP, R-3b, R-4, R-5, R-5a, R-5b, C and R-PRD, Article XX (Zoning Hearing Board), Article XXII (300-127 to 300-138.1, the wireless section only in part) and Article XXIII (conditional uses). Not read: Article II, XIII (OSP), XV (P-O), XVI (I), XVIII (signs), XIX, XXI, XXIV, XXV and the rest of 300-138.2. No definition of family was found in 300-1. The C district permits any R-3a use, but 'No building may be erected, altered or used partly as a residence and partly for commercial purposes' (300-89). 300-39.4 (R-3b) sets side yards for a two-family detached dwelling, though R-3b lists only R-3 uses and single-family semidetached dwellings.

No ADU use

status.note: No district lists a second dwelling unit on a house lot, and each district permits its listed uses 'and for no other'. A unit inside the house would make it a two-family dwelling, listed only in R-4 and R-5

status_by_form.note: 'An accessory building shall not be used as living quarters or sleeping quarters. No person shall construct within any accessory building any bathroom, laundry facilities, or kitchen.' A new separate dwelling would also be a second principal building, which no house district lists

path.note: A second unit is not a listed use. The Zoning Hearing Board hears variances under MPC 910.2 and 300-122B. No section read bars a use variance

value.name: Two-family detached dwelling, one unit over the other (R-4, R-5)
value.conditions: 'A building designed for and occupied exclusively as a residence for two families, with one family living wholly or partly over the other, and having no party wall in common with an adjacent building' (300-1). Lot area per family: 4,000 sq ft in R-4, 3,000 sq ft in R-5. R-4: front yard 20 ft, side yards 6 ft each and 16 ft together, rear yard 15 ft, building area 40%, impervious 50%. R-5: front 15 ft, side yards 3 ft each and 12 ft together, rear 15 ft, building area 50%, impervious 65%, an average of two on-street or off-street parking spaces per dwelling erected (300-53.1). Elsewhere one off-street space on a lot where a dwelling is erected or converted (300-133A)
value.note: A building type. Whether an existing house may be altered into one is not stated, but lot area applies to a building 'erected, altered or used in whole or in part as a dwelling'. A side-by-side two-family semidetached dwelling was repealed in R-5 in 2019 (Ord. No. 814)

districts_read_no_listing.note: R-5a permits single-family houses, apartment houses (three acres or more) and townhouses, with caretaker quarters only inside an apartment house. R-5b permits multiple dwellings and townhouses on 10 acres. C permits R-3a uses and commercial uses but bars a building used partly as a residence and partly for commercial purposes. R-PRD permits single-family detached, semidetached and attached dwellings on a 20 acre tract

types_allowed.note: No ADU use. A unit in an accessory building is barred (300-130). A unit inside the house is possible only as a two-family detached dwelling in R-4 or R-5

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: 'no accessory building ... shall exceed 10 feet in wall height or 20 feet in height at the peak of the roof' in the residence districts and P-O

accessory_structure_threshold_sqft.note: The Zoning Hearing Board grants it by special exception, and the building must then meet the district front, side and rear yards

front_yard_barred.note: Only in a side or rear yard, at least 10 ft behind the rearmost part of the house (in R-3b, R-4 and R-5 behind it)

setback_side_ft.note: One accessory building in a side yard, 5 ft from any property line and 10 ft behind the rearmost part of the house

spaces_required.note: No ADU use. 'Not less than one off-street parking space shall be provided on any lot on which a dwelling is hereafter erected or converted.' R-5: an average of two spaces per dwelling erected (300-53.1)
